purpose: Review-only motion reference for replacing full-corridor laser startup with a boss-attached charge orb and a 0.30-second growing active beam.

motion_contract.charge: Boss-attached round danger-red orb is the only pre-fire warning; no predicted line, corridor, endpoint, or floor tint.
motion_contract.emission: The borderless filled laser grows outward from the orb over approximately 0.30 seconds instead of appearing at full length in one frame.
motion_contract.shape: The boss-side origin merges into the orb and the moving tip is rounded; there is no black perimeter or side outline.
motion_contract.active: At full extension the beam may hold as the damaging corridor, with its inner core contained inside the red body.

known_contract_conflict: VISUAL_SYSTEM.md currently requires a full exact-width startup corridor. Implementing this user-approved direction requires updating that startup rule while retaining exact collision ownership for the growing and fully active beam.
